metadata.hash_projection_rule: evidence_policy_definition_hash = H_WCJ(policy_definition) - metadata is OUTSIDE the hash input (RV6 s2 / pN C2). policy_definition contains ASCII keys and ASCII string, integer, and boolean values only - no floats, no null, no non-ASCII (RV7 R-4 corrected wording). For this subset, H_WCJ equals sha256 of RFC8785-canonical JSON (UTF-16 and ASCII key orders coincide).
metadata.informative_non_learned_grade_bound: SCRIPTED/WAIT reach HASH_BOUND_REPRODUCED(3); EXACT_TRAIN_TIME(4) is MECHANICALLY rejected (proof_policy._kind_grade_inapplicable - pN step-13 B2 upgraded this from prose to a machine rule); same closed-loop ceiling row as HB so no functional loss (G-4)
metadata.informative_step13_delta: v1.9 folds pN step-13 B1 (applicability split: profile-neutral classifier with mutually exclusive component-scoped branches + profile overlay), B2 (EXACT x SCRIPTED/WAIT machine rejection), B3 (structured projection field maps + 7 golden vectors incl. reorder pair), B4 (algorithm-neutral lineage: DEMO_PLUS_RL added to demo-consuming lineage sets; method class/registry live in the parent design). Semantic change - definition hash and file sha differ from the v1.8 line.

claim_targets._rule: EvidenceRecord.claim_target_hash MUST equal the hash derived from the component's target below (mismatch = E_PROOF_MISBOUND). Single reproduction/binding anchor for every component (RV6 s3 / pN C1). The two *_projection targets are defined exactly in projection_rules (RV7 P0-3 / pN step-13 B3).

projection_rules._rule: Exact keyed objects for the two projection claim targets (RV7 P0-3; structured field maps per pN step-13 B3 - no prose placeholders). All other H_WCJ targets hash the typed spec object itself per design s2.3 composite rules - already unambiguous, no projection needed.

control_mode_projection.precondition: certified definitions always have control_mode KNOWN: EXPLICIT_NONE is type-forbidden on ControlModeSlot (E_SLOT_FORBIDDEN_NONE, design s1.1) and UNKNOWN slots are not certifiable (Draft only) - no sentinel encoding exists or is needed
control_mode_projection.golden_totality: the 3 vectors cover the full ControlMode member set

handoff_schema_item.fields: array of semantic_field objects, declared tuple order
handoff_schema_item.required_field_ids: array of string, UTF-8-bytes ascending (frozenset canonicalization)

handoff_schema_projection.order_rationale: declared tuple order preserved - no second canonical order; reordering changes SkillDefinitionHash, BehaviorSignature (design s3-4) and this claim target coherently
handoff_schema_projection.empty_tuple: serializes as []; EXPLICIT_NONE/UNKNOWN states do not exist for tuple-typed definition fields - only slots have states
handoff_schema_projection.golden_note: the producer_handoff_schema_hash value in the vectors is sha256 of ascii x - a syntactically valid 64-hex test constant

proof_policy._domain: (component_kind, evidence_grade, applicability_class) -> exact required ProofKind set; REQUIRED cells only; UNKNOWN grade carries no authority-relevant claim

_kind_grade_inapplicable.rule: identity_kind in [SCRIPTED, WAIT] AND grade == EXACT_TRAIN_TIME -> E_GRADE_INAPPLICABLE, rejected mechanically BEFORE proof inspection (pN step-13 B2: train-time proofs cannot exist for non-learned skills; a synthetic TRAIN_RUN_MANIFEST must not satisfy EXACT)

reproduced_output_rule.note: reproduction anchor for EVERY component including S-group (pN C1 closure); FINAL_ARTIFACT_HASH is NOT required in S cells because claim_target_hash is the anchor there

bindings.rule: artifact_hash == claim_target_hash of the claimed component

bindings.totality_note: RV7 P0-4 + step-13 B4: disjoint whens, total over (identity_kind, training_lineage, component) - LEARNED x NOT_APPLICABLE is impossible by kind-method coherence (design s3); DEMO_PLUS_RL (imitation-plus-RL, single joint stage) anchors to the final config like RL_ONLY/BC_ONLY; TRAINING_DATASET under BC_THEN_RL binds bc_config_hash because the demo dataset is a BC-stage input

bindings.rule: artifact_hash == normalization slot hash when KNOWN; EXPLICIT_NONE slot makes the claim N/A
artifact_hash = binding blob sha256; blob binds (claim_target_hash, train_run_manifest_hash)
artifact_hash == EvidenceRecord.evaluator_artifact_hash AND member of evaluator_registry
artifact_hash = manifest sha256; manifest content lists claim_target_hash
artifact_hash = doc sha256; empty set = explicit empty doc
artifact_hash = H_WCJ of path-sha object array, path bytes ascending

resolvers.name: resolve_artifact
resolvers.contract: (ref, expected_sha256) -> bytes | UNRESOLVED; unresolved or zero-length or sha-mismatch = E_PROOF_ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED

resolvers.name: resolve_git_commit
resolvers.contract: (commit_id_40hex) -> exists | UNRESOLVED; used for SOURCE_COMMIT which carries no artifact_hash; unresolved = E_PROOF_ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED

evaluator_registry_rule.membership: EvidenceRecord.evaluator_artifact_hash must be a member of the evaluator_registry passed to certify_definition
evaluator_registry_rule.certificate_binding: ContractCertificate.evaluator_registry_hash = H_WCJ of sorted evaluator artifact hashes

evaluation_certificates.issued_by: certify_definition issues one EvidenceEvaluationCertificate per evaluated EvidenceRecord; canonical order = component_kind.value bytes ascending (RV7 P0-6)
evaluation_certificates.grade_agreement: EvidenceRecord.grade must equal assigned_grade; mismatch = E_GRADE_MISMATCH (fail-closed - grade is a measured value, not self-asserted)
evaluation_certificates.result_binding: ContractCertificate.evidence_evaluation_bundle_hash = H_WCJ(issued evaluation certificates in canonical order)
evaluation_certificates.eligibility_source: evaluate_usage_eligibility consumes assigned_grade from the evaluation certificates, verified against certificate.evidence_evaluation_bundle_hash (mismatch = E_CERT_INPUT_MISMATCH)

applicability_rules.split_rationale: pN step-13 B1: the former flat rule list had two order-3 rules whose else_result was not component-scoped (sequential evaluation could absorb unrelated components into OPTIONAL/REQUIRED) and REQUIRED_profile_min_grade was undefined at requested_profile null. Fixed by splitting into a profile-neutral classifier (mutually exclusive component-scoped branches, explicit default fallthrough) and a profile overlay applied only at eligibility.

classifier.signature: classify_applicability(identity_kind, training_lineage, explicit_none_components, component) -> NOT_APPLICABLE | OPTIONAL | REQUIRED_CLASS
classifier.used_at: certification (profile-neutral - REQUIRED_CLASS carries no min_grade) and as stage 1 of eligibility

branches.scope_note: the else applies ONLY when component == TRAINING_DATASET - never to any other component
the else applies ONLY when component == TRAINING_PROVENANCE

branches.note: explicit default fallthrough - components without a named branch classify REQUIRED_CLASS unless caught by priority 1

classifier.totality: branches are component-scoped and mutually exclusive: exactly one branch applies for every (component, lineage, explicit_none) input

profile_overlay.signature: resolve_applicability(classification, requested_profile, component) -> REQUIRED(min_grade) | NOT_APPLICABLE | OPTIONAL
profile_overlay.precondition: requested_profile MUST be non-null - the overlay exists only at eligibility; certification never calls it (closing the null-profile undefined-min_grade defect)
profile_overlay.rule: NOT_APPLICABLE if classification == NOT_APPLICABLE OR the profiles cell for (component, requested_profile) is a dash; OPTIONAL if classification == OPTIONAL and the cell is not a dash; REQUIRED(min_grade = profiles table value) if classification == REQUIRED_CLASS and the cell is not a dash
profile_overlay.precedence_note: observationally equal to the RV7 P0-2 order (instance -> profile-dash -> lineage -> default): the dash override implements the profile layer and the classifier implements the other three

regression_vectors: OFFLINE_REPLAY x LEARNED x BC_ONLY x TRAINING_DATASET -> NOT_APPLICABLE (dash override; the v1.7.1 order wrongly yielded REQUIRED)
any profile x LEARNED x RL_ONLY x POLICY_ARTIFACT -> REQUIRED (never absorbed by the TD/TP else branches - component-scoped)
certification (no profile) x LEARNED x BC_ONLY x TRAINING_DATASET -> REQUIRED_CLASS with no min_grade requested
applicability_rules.corpus_requirement: full enumeration 13 components x 5 lineages x (3 profiles + profile-neutral) as a generated golden expectation table - design s8
applicability_rules.invariant: NOT_APPLICABLE is not UNKNOWN; N/A = validated absence excluded from aggregation; UNKNOWN = rank 0, disqualifying, never exempt

not_applicable.TRAINING_PROVENANCE: provenance does not affect replay validity; recording duty stays

usage_ceiling.rule: usage matrix is a ceiling not an authority grant
usage_ceiling.closed_loop_authority: requires evaluate_authority_grant conjuncts: acceptance_test, two_key_O0_S0_V0, independent_safety_gate
